approach.title: Hormone Health Care that Takes Women Seriously.
approach.body: We take time to know you: your story, your life and what you have been carrying, not just your symptoms. Because hormones, metabolism and micronutrients are one connected system, we look at the whole picture. You leave understood, informed and hopeful.
approach.image_alt: Dr. Isabella Wilden in a white blazer, seated at a table with a laptop

trust.title: Trusted by patients, backed by partners.

how.title: Three easy steps, no waiting room.
how.intro: Everything happens in one secure place, from booking and blood results to follow-up care. You’ll always know what comes next.

cta.body: Ready to take the next step? Choose a convenient time in our secure patient portal.
cta.label: Schedule an appointment

steps.title: Book an Appointment
steps.body: Schedule your appointment online at a time that suits you. Please submit relevant blood work and your completed medical history form at least 48 hours in advance of your initial consultation – both can be done easily via your patient portal.

steps.title: Initial Video Consultation
steps.body: Your doctor will review your symptoms and laboratory results and discuss treatment options with you in detail. Where appropriate, prescribed medications can be delivered directly to you at home.

steps.title: Follow-Up Care
steps.body: Your treatment will be reviewed regularly and adjusted as needed. Your patient portal will keep you up-to-date and connected with your doctor between appointments.

note.title: Important information
note.body: Online consultations suit most patients. If a physical examination or further diagnostics, such as an ultrasound or mammogram, are medically necessary, your doctor will recommend the appropriate next step.
